content:
Hello. I'm Aki Tajima. I've been building my Riemann Hypothesis formalization in LEAN.
I've just started to use Lean, but I already noticed it's a very excellent and useful mechanism. I especially like that it can make mathematical proof very clear and exact.

This time, I have built some theorems for my project. So if possible, I'd like to contribute something too.
Please let me know if there is something I can help with.
Anyway, nice to meet you all. :)
